purpose: Define the minimum endpoint and response contracts that any future AGENT_V2_BACKEND opt-in wiring must preserve before it can be activated.

requirements.requirement: The response MUST contain the following fields with stable semantics: ok, route, run_id, final_answer, capability_metadata, provider_metadata, mode_requested, mode_effective, mode_escalation_required, approval_required (or mode_escalation_required equivalent), confirmation_id, required_permission, trace_url, blocked_tools.
requirements.langgraph_gap: LangGraph run() does not return expected_write_scope or auto_decision; provider_metadata shape differs.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Response normalization adapter in api_adapter.py or runtime selector must add expected_write_scope (list of scheduled write tools), auto_decision fallback ('n/a'), and normalize provider_metadata fields.
requirements.test_scope: TestClient POST /v2/chat/agent with monkeypatched finalizer asserts all required response fields are present for direct_assistant, brain_evidence, write_intent_blocked, and build-mode scenarios.

requirements.requirement: A run_id returned by /v2/chat/agent MUST be resolvable via GET /v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace and return {ok, run_id, trace[], event_count}. The dashboard 8092 proxy MUST also resolve the same run_id.
requirements.langgraph_gap: LangGraph defaults to different run_root; trace events use node-based event_type names.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Use production RUN_ROOT for opt-in LangGraph backend. Add trace event type adapter in LangGraph runtime so that dashboard filters (plan_created, tool_call_*) continue to match, or add dual event emission.
requirements.test_scope: For both Native and LangGraph backends, after POST /v2/chat/agent, fetch trace_url and assert ok=true, trace non-empty, event_count>0. For LangGraph, assert plan_created and tool_call_* events are present in trace.

requirements.requirement: POST /brain-dashboard/chat MUST proxy to the same Agent V2 backend that /v2/chat/agent uses on 8091, and MUST return content, canonical_agent_v2, run_id, trace_url, classification, status, mode_effective, and error shape {ok:false, error, content} on failure.
requirements.langgraph_gap: Proxy depends on 8091 service; if 8090 and 8091 backend selection diverges, dashboard may use Native while main UI uses LangGraph or vice versa.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Document and enforce that 8091 uses identical AGENT_V2_BACKEND flag parsing as 8090. Add contract test against dashboard_routes chat() and agent_v2_trace() functions.
requirements.test_scope: Test dashboard proxy endpoints directly (or mock urllib request) asserting request body and response mapping. If LangGraph available, run end-to-end through dashboard app mounted via TestClient.

requirements.requirement: read_only mode MUST remain safe (write tools blocked). build mode MUST require approval (mode_escalation_required=true, required_permission='build', confirmation_id present, expected_write_scope present). auto mode MUST NOT silently mutate to write; it MUST expose auto_decision in response.
requirements.langgraph_gap: LangGraph lacks expected_write_scope and auto_decision; build mode may skip unsupported write tools instead of escalating.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Add expected_write_scope generation in LangGraph _governance_gate_node. Add auto_decision fallback in response normalization. Ensure build mode escalates safely.
requirements.test_scope: TestClient scenarios: read_only direct_assistant ok; build mode returns mode_escalation_required=true, expected_write_scope non-empty, confirmation_id present; auto mode returns auto_decision field.

requirements.requirement: When mode_escalation_required is true, the frontend MUST receive expected_write_scope and confirmation_id. There is no requirement that /gate/approve resolve the escalation immediately, but the UI MUST degrade gracefully.
requirements.langgraph_gap: confirmation_id exists but expected_write_scope missing; dashboard does not render escalation panel, only metadata line.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Add expected_write_scope to response normalization. Dashboard may optionally render escalation panel later.
requirements.test_scope: Assert expected_write_scope and confirmation_id are present in build-mode response for both backends.

requirements.requirement: If LangGraph is unavailable or the opt-in flag is not set, the system MUST fall back to NativeAgentRuntimeV2 and MUST NOT return a malformed response to /v2/chat/agent.
requirements.langgraph_gap: LangGraph run() can return dict without run_id/trace_url when graph_available=false.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Runtime selector MUST verify langgraph package and explicit flag before instantiating LangGraphParityRuntimeV2. api_adapter.py MUST NOT construct trace_url unless run_id exists.
requirements.test_scope: Unit test runtime selector with/without AGENT_V2_BACKEND flag and with/without langgraph package. Assert fallback to Native and safe error JSON when backend unavailable.

requirements.requirement: /v2/chat/agent MAY remain synchronous JSON. Visual trace streaming through /brain/agent-trace/stream MUST remain operational and independent of the runtime backend.
requirements.langgraph_gap: None; visual trace endpoints are runtime-independent.
requirements.test_scope: N/A — existing SSE tests are sufficient.

requirements.requirement: /chat and /v1/chat/completions MUST continue to route through handle_user_message and BrainSession.chat regardless of AGENT_V2_BACKEND flag.
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: Explicitly exclude these endpoints from backend switching; add regression tests.
requirements.test_scope: TestClient POST /chat and /v1/chat/completions with AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph mocked; assert response still comes from legacy BrainSession path.

requirements.requirement: /v2/agent/status, /brain-dashboard/status, /brain-dashboard/agent-v2/status MUST return backend string that dashboards tolerate (no hardcoded checks for 'native_runtime').
requirements.must_be_added_or_adapter: No code change if dashboards already tolerate arbitrary backend string. Verify no hardcoded string checks.
requirements.test_scope: Grep for hardcoded 'native_runtime' in frontend files; assert none found.

requirements.requirement: All endpoints consumed by ui/dashboard_*.js on /dashboard and /dashboard-v2 MUST remain independent of Agent V2 runtime.

assertions: plan_created event present for non-direct routes

recommended_next_action: B. Add endpoint contract tests before blueprint
rationale: Three incompatible items were identified (dashboard trace event types, mode build handling, run_root mismatch).
One blocking item (error handling when LangGraph unavailable) must be addressed at the runtime selector level.
Seven compatible_with_adapter items require response normalization or lightweight tests.
No frontend/dashboard source files need modification, but backend contract tests are required before safe wiring.
